acceptanceCriteria: Measured before/after wall time for closing N merged full-gate tickets (N>=5) retained in a build-log entry.
Reuse is refused when the seal is not an ancestor of the PASS commit or the PASS was not on the declared protected ref; receipt audit verifies ancestry; focused tests cover accept and both refusals.
Spec requirement (CAL-V0 amendment of CAL-V0-240) recorded.
body: Observed 2026-10-21 during the delivered-but-open sweep: 110 verified tickets across 100 distinct seal trees; 18 require full-gate. CAL-V0-240 reuse only matches the identical tree, so each close runs `make gate` (tens of minutes; one started 06:16 at host load 38-62 was still running 8+ minutes later) even though every seal is an ancestor of origin/main whose own merge already passed the full merge-queue gate. Proposal: an operator-declared reuse rule letting a recorded full-gate PASS at a tree whose commit descends from the seal (on the protected branch, via the merge queue) qualify, with reusedFrom naming that commit and receipt audit verifying ancestry; or a batch close that runs the gate once at the tip for a set of merged seals.
